blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nxled remained unstoppable, sweeping the skidding Capital1, 25-13, 25-20, 25-18, to inch closer to the semifinals in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at Philsports Arena. Brooke Van Sickle led the unbeaten Chameleons with 13 points as they improved to a 5-0 record, moving within a win of a semifinals berth after completing the sweep in one hour and 29 minutes. MJ Phillips backstopped her with nine points, while middle blocker Jackie Acuña had seven. Both contributed three blocks to Nxled’s 10-0 edge in the blocking department against Capital1.
